TxPoolSummariesBySender.title: txPoolSummariesBySender
TxPoolSummariesBySender.description: Transaction summaries keyed by sender address in bare hex, without the `0x` prefix, then by decimal nonce

additionalProperties.title: txPoolSummariesByNonce
additionalProperties.description: Summaries of one sender's transactions, keyed by decimal nonce

items.title: txPoolSummary
items.description: `recipient: value wei + gas x gasPrice gas`, where the recipient is bare hex without the `0x` prefix, and the value and gas price are decimal wei. The recipient is empty when the transaction creates a contract.
